title: Rails route listing is exposed
summary: The Rails routes page is reachable, which maps every route and its controller action for an attacker.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Helper") and body_contains("Controller#Action") and body_differs(control)

remediate: This page is only meant for development; make sure the app runs in production mode.
